given: a SKU's stock record has no par level recorded
when: the operator opens the detail view for that SKU
then: the par level region shows a clear "not tracked" message instead of a blank region or a null-related error

independence.rationale: AC1 and AC2 concern the location rows and the tracking code. This AC asserts the optional par level's absent-value presentation. The "not tracked" message can be missing (blank/crash) while rows and tracking code render correctly, and vice versa, so it is independently breakable.

architectural_notes: Optional-field absent-value handling split across the read boundary and the view (NFR-F1-sku-detail-clean-render). The repository/service (app/repositories/, app/services/) emit a clean JSON payload with the par level's null PRESERVED (not omitted, not coerced), never a 4xx/5xx on missing optional detail — the clean-render contract owned in app/routes/ (renders_via react). The 'not tracked' presentation of that null is a view responsibility in the React SPA (client/). Cross-cutting: null/optional-field rendering is owned by boundary payload shape + client presentation, not the domain, so no null leaks into a blank region or a crash.
